:= by
  let K := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C i).obj I
  let f : K ⟶ L := ι
  have h_quasi_iso_at_i : QuasiIsoAt f i := QuasiIsoAt.of_refl _
  have h_injective : CategoryTheory.Injective K := inferInstance
  have h_K_is_k_injective : CochainComplex.IsKInjective K := 
    CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective L (fun n => by exact_instance) 
  have h_L_is_strictly_ge : L.IsStrictlyGE i := inferInstance
  have h_L_has_homology : ∀ (n : ℤ), HomologicalComplex.HasHomology L n := 
    fun n => by exact_instance
  have h_K_has_homology : ∀ (n : ℤ), HomologicalComplex.HasHomology K n := 
    fun n => by exact_instance
  have h_quasi_iso_K_ι_trunc_le : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i) :=
    CochainComplex.quasiIso_ιTruncLE_iff.mp 
      (by rw [CochainComplex.ιTruncLE_eq_singleFunctor_ι]; exact inferInstance)
  have h_quasi_iso_L_π_trunc_ge : QuasiIso (L.πTruncGE i) :=
    CochainComplex.quasiIso_πTruncGE_iff.mp 
      (by rw [CochainComplex.πTruncGE_eq_singleFunctor_π]; exact inferInstance)
  have h_quasi_iso_between_truncs : QuasiIso (K.ιTruncLE i ⟶ L.πTruncGE i) :=
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective.quasiIso_iff.mp 
      (by exact h_K_is_k_injective) 
      (by exact h_L_is_strictly_ge) 
      (by exact h_quasi_iso_at_i)
  have h_split : f ∘ r = id := by sorry
  exact CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono.mk r h_split
